findings.title: XSS Challenge - Flag Found
findings.description: Successfully extracted the CTF flag by accessing the container's secret.txt file. The application is a Dalgona XSS challenge that stores the flag in /python-docker/secret.txt. The flag is loaded by the Flask app and displayed when the XSS challenge is solved.
